title: a16z Podcast: Software is What Distinguishes the Hardware Winners

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Smartphone components have become a kind of Lego kit for all kinds of consumer technology.
reader_summary.overview: Smartphone components have become a kind of Lego kit for all kinds of consumer technology. Cameras, sensors, and batteries all get mixed and matched in different permutations to create different gadgets. It might be something that enables your connected home, offers a video capture system for cops.

key_points.text: It might be something that enables your connected home, offers a video capture system for cops.
But since practically every component is now available to everyone -- and the manufacturing expertise to tie it all together as well -- it becomes very hard to distinguish via hardware alone..
Software is the key to breaking from the pack, say Benedict Evans and Steven Sinofsky in this post-2016 CES podcast.
